top_signals.title: Microsoft pauses KB5002907 update after Office license deactivations
top_signals.summary: Microsoft has paused the rollout of the KB5002907 Microsoft 365 update after users report that it deactivated, or in some cases completely removed, perpetual Office 2016 and Office 2019 installations. [...]
